subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned 20-open-PR policy announcement remain open as the canonical contributor-facing notice, or should maintainers retire it now that docs and automation enforce the policy?
rationale: Automated cleanup should not override the explicit maintainer reopen/pin for a repository contribution policy; the remaining choice is communication policy, not code correctness.

options.title: Keep Pinned Notice
options.body: Leave this issue open and pinned as the current contributor-facing explanation for the 20-PR cap.

options.title: Retire Notice
options.body: Close it only after maintainers decide that CONTRIBUTING and automation are sufficient without a pinned issue.

options.title: Change Policy
options.body: If the cap or exception path changes, update the pinned notice, CONTRIBUTING, labeler, and Barnacle together.

recommendation.title: Keep Pinned Notice
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and pinned as the current contributor-facing explanation for the 20-PR cap.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman is the maintainer actor who renamed, pinned, and reopened the notice after the earlier implementation.
